# Licorice Note (Sage trait)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Licorice Note
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-trait, buff, crit

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Sage hero trait: scent-bottle Elixir Effect bonuses, Pungent cross-apply, crit-weighted dmg_additional_on_crit, Scattered Spore.

## Implementation (engine model)

Modeled in `licorice_note.py::apply` (registered by `trait_id` in `hero_traits/__init__.py`). The base node being disabled (`slot_levels[0] < 1`) turns the whole trait off. Scent-Bottle bonuses are slot-scoped (Basic = slot 2, Special = slot 3 only with `Licorice Tincture Blend`). Per the Bonus/Additional wording rule: Artificial Moon (base L5) emits `elixir_effect_additional` +0.12 per Scent-Bottle slot; Scent of Ambition (L60) emits global `elixir_effect_additional` (`_SCENT_OF_AMBITION` [0.24..0.36]) plus `elixir_duration_additional` −0.30; Everlasting Nectar (L75) reads `life_mana_bonus` (max increased Life/Mana) and emits `elixir_effect_inc = min(lm × _NECTAR_RATIO, _NECTAR_CAP)`. Pungent (L45) cross-applies `sb_elixir_effect` (slot-2 `elixir_effect_inc`, stashed in `stash`) × `_PUNGENT_RATIO` [2.0..3.2], capped per kind, to ONE designated Empower/Curse via `empower_effect_inc`/`curse_effect_inc` slot-scoped to it (`_designated`; auto if exactly one). Elixir of Immortality converts stashed `excess_life/mana_restoration` → `temporary_life/mana_flat` (×2/3, capped) → `dmg_additional`. `_FULL_UPTIME = 1.0`. NYI: Ingredient effects, restoration "cannot be removed", Twinspine Flower. An Activation-Medium/Preparation support on the prepared skill's slot voids the Pungent bonus (warned in `status_lines`).
